module_summary: SERV instruction decoder: latches opcode/funct3/selected instruction bits on bus ack, then combinationally decodes them into control flags for state, ALU, memory, CSR, bufreg and immediate units.

anchors.name: opcode
anchors.why: Latched 5-bit opcode held during execution; source of nearly all decode flags.

anchors.name: funct3
anchors.why: Latched funct3 field steering ALU, memory, CSR and branch decodes.

anchors.name: op20
anchors.why: Representative latched instruction bit (op20/21/22/26) for CSR and system decode.

anchors.name: imm30
anchors.why: Latched bit 30 selecting sub and signed shift.

anchors.name: i_wb_rdt
anchors.why: Instruction word from bus; fields latched into decode registers.

anchors.name: i_wb_en
anchors.why: Load enable latching instruction fields when fetch completes.

anchors.name: csr_op
anchors.why: CSR access instruction decode feeding all CSR enables.

anchors.name: csr_valid
anchors.why: Distinguishes RF-stored CSRs from serv_csr-held ones.

anchors.name: co_mdu_op
anchors.why: MDU instruction decode, disabled by MDU parameter by default.

anchors.name: o_two_stage_op
anchors.why: Flags two-stage instructions (mem, shift, branch, slt) to the state unit.

anchors.name: o_branch_op
anchors.why: Branch/jump instruction flag to state unit.

anchors.name: o_shift_op
anchors.why: Shift instruction flag to state and bufreg.

anchors.name: o_rd_op
anchors.why: Instruction writes rd.

anchors.name: o_dbus_en
anchors.why: Load/store instruction: enable data bus access.

anchors.name: o_ctrl_jal_or_jalr
anchors.why: Jump decode steering PC control unit.

anchors.name: o_ctrl_mret
anchors.why: mret decode to control/CSR.

anchors.name: o_e_op
anchors.why: ecall/ebreak exception instruction decode.

anchors.name: o_alu_rd_sel
anchors.why: One-hot ALU result select (add, slt, bool) from funct3.

anchors.name: o_alu_sub
anchors.why: ALU subtract for sub, branches, slt.

anchors.name: o_mem_cmd
anchors.why: Memory command: store vs load.

anchors.name: o_csr_en
anchors.why: Enables access to RF-stored CSRs.

anchors.name: o_csr_source
anchors.why: CSR write/set/clear operation select from funct3.

anchors.name: o_immdec_en
anchors.why: Per-field immediate decoder enables by instruction format.

anchors.name: o_immdec_ctrl
anchors.why: Immediate format control bits for immediate decoder.

anchors.name: o_bufreg_rs1_en
anchors.why: Bufreg adds rs1 (jalr, mem, shift).

anchors.name: o_op_b_source
anchors.why: Operand B source: rs2 vs immediate.

anchors.name: o_rd_alu_en
anchors.why: Selects ALU result for rd writeback.

groups.name: Instruction field registers
groups.description: Latch opcode, funct3 and selected bits when instruction arrives.

groups.name: State/control decode
groups.description: Instruction class flags for state machine and PC control.

groups.name: ALU/memory decode
groups.description: ALU operation and memory access decodes from funct3/opcode.

groups.name: CSR decode
groups.description: CSR address, enables and operation select.

groups.name: Operand/immediate decode
groups.description: Immediate format, bufreg and operand/writeback source decodes.
